title: SLIIT Game Jam
organizerUniversity: Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology
description: A 48-hour game jam built around a surprise theme revealed at kickoff. Any engine is welcome, from Unity and Godot to a from-scratch canvas game; playable builds are demoed live to a panel of local studio devs.
whoCanParticipate: Open to all undergraduates, artists and designers included. Teams of 1-5.
